title: Romania's Twin Crisis: Energy Shocks and Fiscal Drift Test Bucharest's… · 20 Aug
keywords: Romania, energy crisis, Danube drought, nuclear reactor, Cernavodă, fiscal deficit, inflation, Fitch Ratings, EU economic governance, political instability, energy security, budget consolidation, sovereign debt, Eastern Europe
notes: A severe drought has pushed Romania's power grid to the edge, threatening to shut down the country's last operating nuclear reactor while low Danube water levels trigger emergency rationing measures. At the same time, political fragmentation is undermining the government's ability to repair a strained public budget, drawing warnings from credit rating agencies and raising doubts in Brussels about Bucharest's economic governance.
